    <script>
        require(['jquery', 'headroom', 'jquery-headroom'], function($) {

                $('html').headroom({ offset: 179});

            else if (($(window).width() < 1024) && $(window).width > 640) {
                $('html').headroom({ offset: 43});
            } else {
                $('html').headroom({ offset: 35});
            }

            var calendarButton;
            $(window).resize(function(){
                if ($(window).width() < 768) {
                    calendarButton = document.querySelector('.c-navigation__calendar');
                    console.log(calendarButton);
                    if (calendarButton != null) {
                        addEvent();
                    }
                }

            }).trigger('resize');

            function addEvent() {
                calendarButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    //console.log('click');
                    var mobileNavElement = document.querySelector('.c-navigation-mobile');
                    var mobile_nav = ko.dataFor(mobileNavElement);
                    mobile_nav.closeMenu();

                    var searchElement = document.querySelector('.c-search--popout');
                    var search = ko.dataFor(searchElement);
                    search.closeSearch();

                    var scoreboard = document.querySelector('.s-scoreboard');
                    var html = document.querySelector('html');

                    calendarButton.classList.toggle('is-active');
                    scoreboard.classList.toggle('is-open');
                    html.classList.toggle('mobile-scoreboard-is-open');
                });
            }

            if ($('.s-stories stories-component').length) {
                var observedNodeStories = $('.s-stories stories-component')[0];
                var listObserverStories = new MutationObserver(function(){
                    let slider = observedNodeStories.querySelector('.slick-list');
                    slider.tabIndex = -1;
                    listObserverStories.disconnect();
                });
                listObserverStories.observe(observedNodeStories, {attributes: true, childList: true});
            }

            if ($('.s-promo ads-component').length) {
